# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We pledge to make participation in ChronoStream a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of background, experience level, or identity.

## Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contributes to a positive environment:
- Demonstrating empathy, patience, and respect toward fellow contributors and users
- Giving and gracefully accepting constructive technical feedback
- Focusing on what is best for the project and its users

Examples of unacceptable behavior:
- Harassment, insults, or derogatory comments
- Trolling, public or private intimidation, or publishing others' private information

## Enforcement

Instances of abusive or unacceptable behavior may be reported to **satyamranatc@gmail.com**. All reports will be reviewed promptly and confidentially.
